It also notes accelerated satellite internet deployment, including the national low-orbit constellation and the Qianfan commercial constellation, and completed testing of direct-to-satellite phone connectivity.

title_en: China's normalized assistance achieves a steady start
summary_en: CCTV reports that this year, the first of China's normalized assistance efforts, a policy system covering monitoring and assistance plus industrial and employment support has been basically established to prevent any large-scale return to poverty; monitoring mechanisms are operating effectively, industrial support is expanding, and the central government has allocated 177 billion yuan in normalized assistance funds, with more than 32 million people lifted out of poverty now employed.

title_en: Financial Services for the Real Economy Continue to Improve in Quality and Efficiency
summary_en: The People's Bank of China's latest report says the moderately loose monetary policy has continued to take effect this year, with relatively accommodative social financing conditions and improving quality and efficiency in financial services for the real economy; by end-June, loans to technology, green, inclusive, elderly care, and digital economy sectors continued to grow faster than total loans, and the weighted average interest rate on new loans to small, medium, and micro private enterprises fell 40 basis points year-on-year, benefiting about 2.5 million market entities. In the next stage, the PBOC will use and adjust monetary policy tools as appropriate to keep liquidity ample and social financing conditions relatively loose, strengthen coordination with fiscal policy, and step up countercyclical adjustment to expand domestic demand and optimize supply.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: China Advances Comprehensive Beautiful China Initiative
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 13, an official from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment briefed on progress in building a Beautiful China, reporting that in the first seven months of the 15th Five-Year Plan's opening year, national average PM2.5 concentration fell 6.2% year-on-year and the share of days with good air quality rose 3.9 percentage points, while surface water at Grade I-III reached 86.5%. The ministry aims by 2030 to bring national PM2.5 below 27 micrograms per cubic meter, raise the share of good-quality water bodies to 85%, complete environmental improvement in 80,000 administrative villages, and support about 200 cities in building "zero-waste cities."

title_en: Tianjin Continues to Strengthen Port Support and Promote Integrated Port-Industry-City Development
summary_en: Tianjin is leveraging its port advantages to develop modern shipping services and integrate port, industry, and city development under the 15th Five-Year Plan, with the city's port container routes reaching 152 and a goal of 600 billion yuan in output value for five major port-related industries in Binhai New Area by 2030.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, episodes five and six of the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air tonight (August 13) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast on the science and education channel at 10 p.m.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Making the 'Cake' Bigger and Narrowing Gaps — Zhejiang Solidly Advances Construction of Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone
summary_en: The segment reports on Zhejiang's progress in building the common prosperity demonstration zone since May 2021, including upgraded mountain-sea cooperation pairing mechanisms, county-level industrial development, and rural revitalization through the 'Ten Thousand Villages' initiative, with the urban-rural income ratio narrowing from 1.96 to 1.81 and rural per capita disposable income reaching 27,555 yuan in the first half of the year.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Houthi claims of missile and drone strikes on Saudi-linked targets in Yemen's Taiz and Marib provinces, including an attack on a vessel in the Bab al-Mandab Strait that Yemeni coast guard described as a commercial ship, with no Saudi response; Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi's visit to Iran and Defense Minister Khawaja Asif's remarks that the US and Iran are close to an agreement; and Congo's Ebola outbreak surpassing 2,000 deaths out of nearly 4,400 confirmed cases.

title_en: Severe Earthquake Disaster in Colombia as Rescue Efforts Intensify
summary_en: CCTV News reports that a magnitude-7.5 earthquake in northwestern Colombia has killed 188 people and injured 1,677, according to statistics released on the 11th by the National Federation of Departments of Colombia, with rescue operations intensifying; UN Secretary-General António Guterres issued a statement through Deputy Spokesperson Farhan Haq saying the UN is in close contact with the Colombian government and supports its relief work, and the World Food Programme has launched assistance at Colombia's request.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China has allocated 3.196 billion yuan in central funds for drainage capacity projects in 13 key regions, that the Yellow River has flowed continuously for 27 years, and that China delivered the world's largest multi-purpose heavy-lift vessel; it also covers the C919's first international commercial route to Ulaanbaatar and the departure of the Navy's 49th escort task force for the Gulf of Aden.

title_en: National Vegetable Supply Situation Generally Stable
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's in-field vegetable acreage has reached 106 million mu, with coordinated scheduling and staggered harvests ensuring ample market supply; highland and northern summer-autumn vegetable areas are now the mainstay of supply as southern open-field vegetables slow due to sustained high temperatures, and major supermarkets and wholesale markets are broadening procurement channels, keeping overall prices stable and controllable.

title_en: Localities and Departments Actively Respond to Severe Rainstorms
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that heavy rainfall from the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin has hit central and eastern China, prompting emergency responses: flash flooding in Yuzhou, Henan, where a villager was rescued after clinging to a tree; train suspensions and speed restrictions in Zhengzhou; the national flood control emergency response for Henan raised from Level IV to Level III; over 14,100 people evacuated in Xiangyang, Hubei; and an orange rainstorm warning in Beijing with drainage crews deployed and 77 elevated roads opened for emergency parking.

title_en: Nuclear Power Construction Steadily Advances, Total Installed Capacity Ranks First in the World
summary_en: CCTV reports that China has stepped up nuclear power project construction this year, with 57 approved units under construction—more than half the global total—and total installed capacity of operating and approved units reaching 135 million kilowatts, the world's largest. In late July, eight more units were approved, the first batch under the 15th Five-Year Plan, as China continues its "active, safe and orderly development" principle and expands the coastal nuclear power belt.

title_en: China's Auto Exports Continue Strong Growth Momentum
summary_en: CCTV News reported on August 12, citing the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, that China's auto exports reached 1.043 million vehicles in July, up 81.3% year-on-year, with new energy vehicle exports at 553,000 units, up 145.5% year-on-year. Monthly exports exceeded one million vehicles for two consecutive months, with new energy vehicles accounting for over 50% of exports for two consecutive months, which the association attributed to China's complete auto supply chain and advances in intelligent features such as smart driving and cabin interaction.

title_en: Obituary of Comrade Zhu Rongji Issued by the CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, the NPC Standing Committee, the State Council and the CPPCC National Committee announce the death of Zhu Rongji, former premier and Standing Committee member of the 14th and 15th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, who died in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at age 98 after illness. The obituary recounts his career, including his tenure as Shanghai party secretary, vice premier and premier, and credits him with leading fiscal, tax, financial and state-owned enterprise reforms, managing the response to the Asian financial crisis, and completing negotiations for China's WTO accession.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air its third episode, 'Taking Command in Crisis,' and fourth episode, 'Major Breakthroughs,' tonight (August 12) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Comprehensive Multidimensional Transport Network Construction Accelerates Toward Western China's Interior
summary_en: The segment reports that, at the start of the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China is accelerating construction of its comprehensive multidimensional transport network toward western regions, with the Pinglu Canal beginning full-scale live vessel trials on August 12 ahead of its September opening as a key project of the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor. It cites progress in western highway, rail and airport infrastructure, including a rise in rail operating mileage in the west from 59,100 to 67,300 kilometers over five years and expansion of Kunming Changshui Airport.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the UN Yemen envoy's warning that escalating tensions could plunge Yemen back into full-scale conflict, a surge in Israeli settler violence in the West Bank, a renewed sharp fall in the yen against the dollar, and a joint criticism of FIFA by the UEFA, AFC and CONCACAF over the proposed FIFA Forward company.

title_en: Data shows U.S. average temperature in July reached a new high
summary_en: Citing National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration data released on the 10th, the segment reports that the U.S. average temperature in July reached a record high of about 24.94 degrees Celsius, that July precipitation was the third-lowest on record, and that about half of the United States was in drought as of early August; it also covers drought and wildfires across Europe, including restrictions on water use for about 27 million people in the UK, crisis-level drought in over two-thirds of France's provinces, drought affecting about 95% of Slovakia, and a wildfire in Spain's Huelva province that burned over 200 square kilometers and forced the evacuation of more than 800 residents.

title_en: US Claims Full Control of Strait of Hormuz; Iran Criticizes US Blockade for Hindering Resumption of Shipping
summary_en: US President Trump said the US "100 percent" controls the Strait of Hormuz and that the US military has cleared mines throughout the waterway, while Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said the US naval blockade and military actions against Iran are the main obstacle to fully restoring safe navigation through the strait. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba signed orders reshuffling senior military personnel, and Iranian President Pezeshkian said Mojtaba is in "good health" after a roughly seven-hour meeting.

title_en: Magnitude 7.5 Earthquake Strikes Colombia, Country Enters "State of National Disaster"
summary_en: A magnitude 7.5 earthquake struck northwestern Colombia with a depth of 80 kilometers, killing 132 people, injuring 570, and severely affecting 32 cities, prompting the country to declare a "state of national disaster." President Juan Manuel Santos said the top priority is rescuing people trapped under the rubble.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's large internet companies posted over 1 trillion yuan in internet business revenue in the first half of 2026, that the 15th Five-Year Plan will establish a national master catalog of immovable cultural relics, that the market regulator approved 338 national standards, and that the first round of a deepened anti-organized-crime campaign led to more than 8,200 arrests; it also covers 29.9% growth in China-Laos Railway import-export value in the first seven months, the hoisting of the world's first 500-megawatt impulse hydropower unit rotor at the Zhala hydropower station in Tibet, and the 38th Hundred Flowers Film Awards in Beijing.

title_en: [Cultural China Tour] Ancient Scripts Project Unveils the Veil of Remote Antiquity
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's major cultural project on ancient scripts and the transmission of Chinese civilization has entered the final stage of its first phase, with an exhibition of more than 270 items at the National Museum of China showcasing oracle bone inscriptions, bronze inscriptions, and bamboo and silk manuscripts, alongside achievements such as a major oracle bone compilation and the training of over 1,300 students.

title_en: Party Flag Flies High at the Grassroots: Warm-hearted Protection in the Storm
summary_en: The segment reports that under the influence of Typhoon Dolphin, parts of Zhejiang experienced sustained heavy rainfall, and Party members and officials worked on the front lines to prevent flooding and eliminate dangers, including a village official who dove into muddy water to clear a blocked drainage outlet in Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, and emergency teams in Xiangshan County, Ningbo, who patrolled aquaculture areas every three hours to protect fish farmers.

title_en: Regions and Departments Actively Respond to Impact of Typhoon Baihaitun
summary_en: Heavy rain from Typhoon Baihaitun caused flooding and water levels above warning thresholds in parts of Jiangsu, Anhui, Hubei and Henan, prompting emergency drainage, evacuations and traffic controls. The National Development and Reform Commission allocated 200 million yuan in central budget investment to support post-disaster recovery in Zhejiang, and the national flood control headquarters launched a Level IV flood response for Beijing and Tianjin.

title_en: China to Accelerate Building of a Modern Coal Industry System
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration jointly released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development, which calls for optimizing coal development layout, raising access standards for coal resource development, phasing out outdated and ineffective capacity, and promoting clean and efficient coal use. By 2030, the share of capacity from large modern coal mines is to reach 87 percent and smart coal mines 75 percent, with coalbed methane output reaching 26 billion cubic meters as a modern coal industry system is basically completed.

title_en: China's Ecological Quality to Improve Steadily During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment has issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Ecological Protection," which sets targets for 2030 including raising the share of land under protected areas to at least 18%, soil and water conservation reaching over 74%, and forest coverage reaching 25.8%. The plan focuses on consolidating the national ecological security barrier system, building a green barrier in the "Three-North" project region, and strengthening biodiversity and habitat protection.

title_en: Locales Seize Farming Season to Improve Field Management
summary_en: The segment reports that regions across China are seizing the farming season to carry out field management tailored to local conditions, including pest and disease control for rice in the northeast, heat-mitigation measures for rice in Jilin, scientific fertilization and pest control for corn in Hebei and Shaanxi, and mechanized harvesting of rice in Sichuan and Guizhou, all aimed at safeguarding a grain harvest.

title_en: Documentary Film 'Jiang Zemin' Begins Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, a 12-part documentary film 'Jiang Zemin,' co-produced by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee, the National Radio and Television Administration, and China Media Group, premieres tonight (August 11) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel and rebroadcasts at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel. The film reviews Jiang Zemin's more than 70-year revolutionary career and highlights his achievements and lofty style; the first episode, 'Weathering Trials,' and the second, 'Daring to Explore,' air today.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
summary_en: The segment reports on China's efforts to strengthen its social security system, citing Xi Jinping's statements on social security as a basic institutional safeguard for livelihoods and social fairness, and describing reforms including Zhejiang's big-assistance information platform that shifts from "people seeking policies" to "policies seeking people," expanded occupational injury protection for new employment forms, the first specialized social assistance law, and the nationwide rollout of long-term care insurance as a "sixth insurance."

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Colombian President over Strong Earthquake in Colombia
summary_en: On August 11, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Colombian President Iván Duque Márquez over the strong earthquake in Colombia, expressing deep sorrow for the casualties and property losses and extending sincere condolences to the bereaved families and the injured on behalf of the Chinese government and people.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that U.S. media say President Trump favors economic pressure on Iran over new military action, that Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Supreme Leader Mojtaba, that Russia and Ukraine exchanged claims of territorial gains and strikes on Odessa and Nizhnekamsk, that Danish protesters held a kayak rally in Copenhagen in support of Greenland, and that wildfires continue in Canada, Albania and Spain.

title_en: Houthi Armed Forces Claim Attacks on Yemeni Government Forces and Saudi Refinery
summary_en: Yemen's Houthi armed forces said they used missiles and drones on August 9 to attack a Yemeni government forces assembly point and weapons depot at Mocha port on the Red Sea coast of Taiz province, an attack Yemeni government forces said on August 10 killed at least 7 people and wounded 30. The Houthis also said they struck a Saudi Aramco refinery with drones in response to recent Saudi drone incursions into Yemeni airspace, while Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry reported a fire at an Aramco refinery facility in Jizan with no casualties but did not state the cause.

title_en: Israeli Prime Minister Says Israel Rejects US-Backed Gaza Peace Plan; US Media Says White House "Does Not Care"
summary_en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on the 9th that Israel rejects the Gaza peace plan proposed by the US-initiated "Board of Peace," insisting that Hamas must genuinely disarm, including heavy and light weapons, or Israeli forces will not withdraw from the Gaza Strip. US media, citing a senior US official, reported that the White House "does not care" about Netanyahu's remarks and views them as a "political need" tied to Israel's election.

title_en: Japanese citizens hold rallies protesting dangerous moves by Takaichi administration to expand military and amend constitution
summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of the Nagasaki atomic bombing, some Japanese citizens held a rally in Nagasaki on the 9th protesting the dangerous moves by the Sanae Takaichi government to expand the military and amend the constitution. In Tokyo, some Japanese citizens also held a protest that day, demanding that the Japanese government face up to its history of aggression and uphold peace.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: CCTV's news roundup reports that China has built about 8 million tons of green fuel production capacity as of end-2025, that cumulative inbound and outbound vehicle crossings at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Zhuhai port have surpassed 25 million, that China's 16th Arctic Ocean expedition is conducting ice station surveys with the Xuelong and Xuelong 2 vessels, and that endangered forest musk deer were filmed in Wuxi County, Chongqing.
